verdict.rationale: Wrangler CLI/config (docs-11, docs-20) is the mechanism for defining bindings, routes, cron, queues, and workflows (docs-9, docs-10), and Cloudflare documents versioning/rollback of deployed Workers via Wrangler or the dashboard (docs-23), which together cover the define/deploy/version lifecycle. However, no evidence explicitly frames wrangler.toml/jsonc as a single file capturing an entire multi-service architecture, nor discusses environments, multi-service composition, or IaC-style full-stack topology in one file. Missing for 10: explicit single-config-file architecture definition across multiple services/environments, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
